title: Shared event photo album
summary: Everyone at a wedding or party drops their photos into one shared album.
whyTempting: Every event ends with 'can you send me those photos?'
whyItFails: Platform features. Google Photos and iCloud shared albums are free and good enough. One-off usage. Users come once per event and churn. Hard to monetise. Consumers won't pay for something that feels like it should be free.
whatWouldChange: Narrow B2B angle: paid by wedding photographers or event venues rather than guests.

attempts.notes: Photo sharing with people nearby; launched to confused users and closed at the end of 2012.

attempts.outcome: Settled with the FTC over facial recognition; told to delete the models

reasons.detail: Platform features: Google Photos and iCloud shared albums are free and good enough.
One-off usage: Users come once per event and churn.
Hard to monetise: Consumers won't pay for something that feels like it should be free.
